report.explanation: Current telemetry does not substantiate any root cause. Gateway metrics show low error rate (0.0012) and p95 77ms with zero dependency timeouts and zero db pool waiters; logs show a 200/ok request. A single ERROR trace on gateway->payment (973ms) is the only anomaly, but payment is downstream of order, not gateway, so the topology contradicts that span. No deployment or memory-retention facts exist. Evidence is insufficient to bound a candidate; hand off for targeted collection.
missing_evidence: Gateway error-rate and p95 latency time series over the alert window to confirm the alert is real
Traces for the order->payment and order->postgresql hops to localize the failing dependency
Payment service error/latency metrics and logs for the same window
Postgresql pool waiters, connection saturation, and query latency metrics
Redis timeout and latency metrics for the inventory->redis hop
Logs with ERROR/WARN level and request_result failures from gateway and order
